note: Literature establishes that BRD4 intragenic alterations cause CdLS-like features while 19p13.12 microdeletions produce a contiguous gene syndrome with variable synophrys and microcephaly expression.

evidence.text: BRD4 point mutations present with Cornelia de Lange syndrome phenotypes, whereas 19p13.12 interstitial deletions overlapping BRD4 result in a broader contiguous gene syndrome due to involvement of neighboring genes.

source.title: Confirmation of BRD4 haploinsufficiency role in Cornelia de Lange–like phenotype and delineation of a 19p13.12p13.11 gene contiguous syndrome
source.quote: Patients harboring a 19p interstitial deletion shared some physical features with BRD4 mutation carriers, which results in a more complex phenotype because of the involvement of several neighboring genes.

evidence.text: Seven reported cases of 19p13.11-p13.12 deletions sharing a 53 kb critical region encompassing BRD4 and AKAP8/AKAP8L exhibited synophrys and microcephaly as part of a recurrent pattern.

source.title: A recognizable phenotype related to 19p13. 12 microdeletion
source.quote: To date, there are seven cases with deletions overlapping the 19p13.11-p13.12 region described in the literature... recognizable phenotype characterized by microcephaly, ear abnormalities, rounded face, synophrys, arched or upwardly angulated eyebrows
